summary: Client-side TypeScript tool that creates interactive knowledge graphs from git repos or ZIPs, enabling browser-based code exploration with a built-in Graph RAG agent, requiring no server.
usecases: On-premise codebase exploration for sensitive environments without data leakage
Rapid onboarding and navigation of large, unfamiliar codebases
Offline knowledge graph generation for local development and debugging
ideas: Combine with embedding models to enable semantic search within the generated knowledge graph
Export the knowledge graph to Neo4j or other graph databases for team-wide collaboration
Add plugin support for custom analysis plugins (e.g., dependency tracking, bug pattern detection)
